source: CRON 20261122: H1 2026 column from the issuer unaudited condensed consolidated interim results for the six months ended 28 February 2026, unit R thousands multiplied by 1,000. The group has sold or agreed to sell its main investments, so the statement reports continuing operations only and the 22362 loss from discontinued operations is excluded here. Revenue 2492 is property revenue 751 plus other revenue 1741. Operating Expenses 11404 is employee benefits 8130 plus operating expenses 3274 across both segments. Operating Profit of 8171 negative is the printed total operating loss, which includes 741 of profit from equity accounted investments. A fair value loss of 6021 sits between that operating loss and the printed loss before tax of 14192 and has no row in this schema. No finance costs and no income tax were recognised. EPS is the printed basic loss per share from continuing operations of 6.3 cents.
